Setting.Name: SendmailModule::OAuth2FunctionalAccount
Setting.Description: If 'XOAUTH2' or 'OAUTHBEARER' is selected in the 'SendmailModule::OAuth2Method' setting, then this setting needs to be enabled and set to a valid OIDC Functional Account. OIDC Accounts can be configured in the Admin UI 'OAuth Functional Accounts' Module.

Setting.Name: SendmailModule::OAuth2Method
Setting.Description: The authentication method to use for SMTP Authentication, defaults to 'Basic Auth'. If 'XOAUTH2' or 'OAUTHBEARER' is selected, then the '"SendmailModule::OAuth2FunctionalAccount' setting needs to be enabled and set to a valid OIDC Functional Account. OIDC Accounts can be configured in the Admin UI 'OAuth Functional Accounts' Module.
